turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

I’ve come in for edema—swelling in my ankles (right and left), my right thigh, the dorsal aspect of my right foot, and my right sole. I’m also having related pain in my right and left ankles, right calf and thigh, and my right sole.
[ASK] Do you have shortness of breath (especially sudden or worsening) that is not explained by a simple cold and may be associated with low oxygen or fluid in the lungs?
[ASK] Do you have sudden shortness of breath that started within the last few hours?
[ASK] Have you had chest pain that is worse when lying down or improved when sitting up (or pain that changes with breathing)?
